summary.text: Pine Crane Pavilion is Immortal Crane Sect's rank six Immortal Gu House. Fang Zheng is inside it on Duke Long's route toward Eastern Sea.

claims.text: Fairy Zi Wei tells Duke Long that Fang Zheng is ready, already on Duke Long’s route, and inside Immortal Crane Sect’s Pine Crane Pavilion. Duke Long does not meet him; he follows secretly and instructs Fang Zheng to head toward Eastern Sea using the house. In immemorial white heaven, Fang Yuan sees the Immortal Gu House fly closer and activates a qi path battlefield he had prepared. Inside Pine Crane Pavilion, Fang Zheng’s vision warps and he is trapped at once; boundless qi currents gather toward the house, and he judges that a rank six Immortal Gu House cannot block a rank eight killer move. Duke Long appears at the crucial moment, breaks the surrounding qi currents, and Fang Yuan reveals himself as Qi Sea Ancestor with a different appearance.

Fang Zheng, still inside Pine Crane Pavilion, sees Duke Long strike first at the disguised Fang Yuan. Duke Long then points behind himself, and a layer of bubbles surrounds the house and protects it. After Fang Yuan’s thousand-foot blade qi smashes Duke Long’s fused qi walls, Fang Zheng’s vision turns dark inside the house, his ears bleed, and Pine Crane Pavilion shakes like a small raft in the aftershock until he steadies it, pale and breathing hard. Fang Yuan later points at Pine Crane Pavilion and taps, sending further blade qi at it.

Air currents from the fight blow through the qi path battlefield until Pine Crane Pavilion sways like a paper boat in a tsunami and would break apart at any moment, while Fang Zheng inside is dizzy and pale. Fang Yuan does not know that his brother Gu Yue Fang Zheng is inside the house, and Fang Zheng does not know that Qi Sea Ancestor is Fang Yuan; Fang Yuan still senses that the person inside is harmful to him, as in the previous life’s battle, and he attacks many times with Pine Crane Pavilion in range. When Duke Long’s reverse worm dragon currents fuse into a huge divine dragon, Pine Crane Pavilion is like a tiny mosquito beside an elephant. Duke Long also brings the house with him when he breaks off a killer move activation to dodge Fang Yuan’s blade qi.

Song Qi Yuan and Shen Cong Sheng, rank eight first supreme elders of Song clan and Shen clan, find Immortal Crane Sect’s Pine Crane Pavilion by chance on an important mission and recognize it as an Immortal Gu House of Central Continent’s ten great ancient sects, sneaking into Eastern Sea and then vanishing. They follow from afar, miss Fang Yuan’s ambush of Duke Long and the house, and arrive after Duke Long and Pine Crane Pavilion are already trapped in the qi path battlefield. Fang Yuan keeps aiming moves at the house as Duke Long’s weakness; when the battlefield breaks, Duke Long pushes Pine Crane Pavilion away on dragon-shaped qi with Fang Zheng still inside, trying to escape the fight. Fang Yuan still flies at the house, and Song and Shen grab Pine Crane Pavilion from the horizon; Fang Zheng, at the moment of life and death, names himself Gu Yue Fang Zheng, Fang Yuan’s brother, and a prospective Heavenly Court member protected by Duke Long.

Duke Long later treats Fang Yuan’s earlier focus of all his attacks on Pine Crane Pavilion as proof that Qi Sea Ancestor can force him into a passive spot and make Heavenly Court wary of an unrestrained Eastern Sea expert visiting Central Continent.
